ShaderNodePreset.Description:
Procedural fireflies - drifting movement, asymmetric flash (fast rise, slow decay, intermittent bursts). Generator over black - Screen or Add downstream onto your plate.
Setup:
- Count: number of fireflies - Seed: reshuffle placement/timing - EdgeMargin: inset of spawn field from frame edge - DriftSpeed / DriftAmount: wander motion - FlashSpeed / FlashRandomness / FlashAttack / FlashDecayPower / FlashSparsity: flash timing - ColorR/G/B, Brightness, TwinkleVariation: look - GlowSize, CoreSize, CoreBrightness: glow shape - ZSpeed, ZNear, ZFar, Spread: depth travel - fireflies swoop in close/huge and recede into the distance, looping - TargetX/Y, TargetLooseness: vanishing point fireflies travel toward/from - animate to fake a camera move's trajectory - ShowTarget: red crosshair at the Target position, setup aid only - turn off before final render - Hero: one always-lit firefly that weaves organically in front of the swarm, its own depth/wander/look, with its own Hero Target X/Y it's roughly attracted to - Show Hero Target: blue crosshair at the Hero Target position, setup aid only - turn off before final render
Made by Marcus M.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: MM Fireflies

Uniform.Name: front
Uniform.Tooltip: Not used by this generator - present only because Matchbox requires a Front input alongside any other texture input. Leave unconnected.

Uniform.Name: sprite
Uniform.Tooltip: Optional colour image drawn in place of the procedural glow/core shape when Use External Input is on. Scales with Glow Size and depth like the normal fireflies. Shape comes from the separate External Sprite Alpha input, not this image's own alpha.

Uniform.Name: spriteAlpha
Uniform.Tooltip: Greyscale shape/matte for the External Sprite - white = fully visible, black = hidden. Leave unconnected to treat the sprite as a fully opaque square.

Uniform.Name: heroSprite
Uniform.Tooltip: Optional colour image for the Hero firefly, drawn in place of its procedural glow/core shape when Hero Use External Input is on. Shape comes from the separate Hero External Sprite Alpha input.

Uniform.Name: heroSpriteAlpha
Uniform.Tooltip: Greyscale shape/matte for the Hero External Sprite - white = fully visible, black = hidden. Leave unconnected to treat the sprite as a fully opaque square.
Each firefly is a per-pixel loop iteration - very high counts will cost render time.
Uniform.Name: Count

Uniform.Tooltip: Draw the connected External Sprite image instead of the procedural glow/core shape.
Uniform.Name: UseSprite
SpriteSize
Uniform.Tooltip: Size multiplier for the External Sprite image, on top of Glow Size/depth scaling.
How fast fireflies travel through depth. 0 = no forward travel (static depth per firefly).
Uniform.Name: ZSpeed

Uniform.Tooltip: How close/huge fireflies start out - as if swooping in from right out of camera. Lower = bigger, punchier swoop.
Uniform.Name: ZNear

Uniform.Tooltip: How far into the distance fireflies recede before looping back to close/huge. Higher = they vanish further away.
Uniform.Name: ZFar

Uniform.Tooltip: How far fireflies sweep outward/inward from centre with depth. 0 = only the size changes, 1 = full perspective swoop.
Uniform.Name: Spread

Uniform.Tooltip: Horizontal position of the vanishing point fireflies travel toward/from, 0-1 across the frame (can go outside 0-1 to sit off-screen). Animate to fake the trajectory implied by a camera move.
Uniform.Name: TargetX

Uniform.Tooltip: Vertical position of the vanishing point, 0-1 across the frame.
Uniform.Name: TargetY

Uniform.Tooltip: How loosely each firefly sticks to the target point, in frame-height units. 0 = every firefly converges to exactly the same point; higher scatters each firefly's own vanishing point around it.
Uniform.Name: TargetLooseness

Uniform.Tooltip: Draws a red crosshair at the Target position as a setup aid. Turn off before final render.
Uniform.Name: ShowTarget

Uniform.Tooltip: Turn on a single always-lit hero firefly that weaves organically in front of the swarm.
Uniform.Name: HeroEnable

Uniform.Tooltip: How fast the hero weaves around the frame.
Uniform.Name: HeroSpeed

Uniform.Tooltip: How far the hero wanders from centre, in frame-height units. Large values let it drift briefly off-screen and back.
Uniform.Name: HeroWander

Uniform.Tooltip: How fast the hero's distance from camera wanders.
Uniform.Name: HeroZSpeed

Uniform.Tooltip: Closest/huge-est the hero gets.
Uniform.Name: HeroZNear

Uniform.Tooltip: Farthest/tiniest the hero recedes to.
Uniform.Name: HeroZFar

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero glow tint - red channel.
Uniform.Name: HeroColorR

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero glow tint - green channel.
Uniform.Name: HeroColorG

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero glow tint - blue channel.
Uniform.Name: HeroColorB

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero overall intensity multiplier.
Uniform.Name: HeroBrightness

Uniform.Tooltip: How fast the hero's glow gently breathes brighter/dimmer.
Uniform.Name: HeroPulseSpeed

Uniform.Tooltip: How much the hero's breathing dips its brightness. 0 = always fully lit.
Uniform.Name: HeroPulseDepth

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero soft glow radius, in frame-height units, before depth scaling.
Uniform.Name: HeroGlowSize

Uniform.Tooltip: Hero hot core radius, before depth scaling.
Uniform.Name: HeroCoreSize

Uniform.Tooltip: Extra intensity the hero's hot core adds on top of its soft glow.
Uniform.Name: HeroCoreBrightness

Uniform.Tooltip: Draw the connected Hero External Sprite image instead of the procedural glow/core shape.
Uniform.Name: HeroUseSprite
HeroSpriteSize
Uniform.Tooltip: Size multiplier for the Hero External Sprite image, on top of Hero Glow Size/depth scaling.
Where the hero is roughly attracted to, horizontally, 0-1 across the frame. Its own wander still orbits loosely around this point.
Uniform.Name: HeroTargetX

Uniform.Tooltip: Where the hero is roughly attracted to, vertically, 0-1 across the frame.
Uniform.Name: HeroTargetY

Uniform.Tooltip: Draws a blue crosshair at the Hero Target position as a setup aid. Turn off before final render.
Uniform.Name: ShowHeroTarget
